# Motion Radar
A free, static, Russian-language research desk for motion design and creative coding.
- Source links and short RSS excerpts remain attributed to their authors.
- analysis.engine=extractive is not an AI summary.
- analysis.engine=transformers or ollama identifies local model output; it may contain mistakes.
- input_kind=rss_excerpt means the full article was not read.
- Repository license metadata does not certify code safety, free models, or free commercial products.
- The public browser never receives API credentials or calls a model service.
